This chunk is about:
- Breeds: Stabyhoun, Griffon Bruxellois, Griffon Belge, Petit Brabançon, Glen of Imaal Terrier, Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
- Concepts: rare dog breeds, canine Chiari-like malformation

Facts:
- The Stabyhoun, also called the Stabij, is one of the five rarest dog breeds in the world.
- Rare breed (dog) refers to any dog breed that has small numbers and includes old established breeds such as the Stabyhoun and Glen of Imaal Terrier as well as newer creations.
- The Griffon Bruxellois may refer to three different breeds: the Griffon Bruxellois, the Griffon Belge, and the Petit Brabançon.
- Canine Chiari-like malformation is rare in most dog breeds but has reportedly become very widespread in the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel and the Griffon Bruxellois, also called the Brussels Griffon.
